modern: As you intend to live when you have gone out,... so it is in your power to live here. But if men do not allow you, then leave life, yet as if you were suffering no harm. The house is smoky, and I leave it. Why do you think this is any trouble? But so long as nothing of the kind drives me out, I remain, am free, and no one shall stop me from doing what I choose; and I choose to do what is according to the nature of the rational and social animal.
original: As thou intendest to live when them art gone out,... so it is in thy power to live here. But if men do not permit thee, then get away out of life, yet so as if thou wert suffering no harm. The house is smoky, and I quit it. Why dost thou think that this is any trouble? But so long as nothing of the kind drives me out, I remain, am free, and no man shall hinder me from doing what I choose; and I choose to do what is according to the nature of the rational and social animal.
